data.title: Lattice orchestrator skill exports CAIRN_* env vars

data.body:
## ✅ ETCH-12 complete — pr_open

**c11 skill change (load-bearing):** commit `d44c94889c1dec5e1f0be62f5483cccc78c9bace` on branch `feat/etch-12-cairn-skill-export`, pushed to `github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11`. Added the CAIRN_* HARD RULE + export block to all three delegator boot templates (fast-track / inline-full / sub-agent-full) and the per-sub-agent role/parent vars on the atomic-cwd launch line. Committed to a dedicated branch so the unrelated active branch (`feat/create-workspace-dialog-tweaks`) was left untouched and restored to its original tip.

**Etch PR:** https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/12 (`feat/etch-12-skill-env`, commit `36b51d7`) — marker doc, 4 contract tests, `.cairn/` gitignore.

**Validation:** `go vet ./...` clean; `go test ./...` all green.

**Smoke test** (per boot prompt — exported the skill's CAIRN block, piped a `session_start` event to a fresh build, read `.wip.jsonl`):
```
.data.orchestration =
{"type":"lattice-orchestrator","dispatch_method":"c11_delegator","ticket_id":"ETCH-12-smoke","run_id":"01TESTRUN","role":"delegator","workflow_version":null,"extra":{}}
```
The orchestration block is populated exactly from the exported vars — capture works end-to-end.

**Note:** a plan-review (pid 43526) was still running headless at PR time; fast-track inlines self-review so it wasn't blocking. Stopping at pr_open per fast-track policy.

Merged via Orchestrator auto-merge (PR #12, squash @ 321af9fea943). Lattice orchestrator skill now exports CAIRN_* env vars in delegator boot prompts. Includes Etch-side test for orchestration env var capture + c11 skill source update.
